title: Operator attention
summary: Landed-work custody reads current memberships and landing receipts each pass. Repository containment reuses definite answers for immutable full commit pairs; unknown comparisons retry and remain visible as unreadable custody. The steering report adds a slow paths section only when a function operation's last-hour p95 passes 5 s or a call passes 30 s; intentional waits such as the relay long-poll stay out.
